slides.title: Open Deploy App
slides.html:
To get you connected to your TAK server, open your Deploy App.

  • Navigate to Home
  • Launch TAK.

slides.title: TAK Page - Instructions
slides.html:
• When you open the TAK page for the first time, you will see the quick instructions.
  • Page should recognize your device's platform. If needed, you can manually change the device platform.

slides.title: TAK Page - General
slides.html: • TAK page is where you get your server connection to your TAK client application.

slides.title: TAK Page - Platform
slides.html:
• Page should auto-recognize your device.
  • If you happen want a package for different platform, you can change it here.

slides.title: TAK Page - ATAK Package
slides.html:
• With Android ATAK, you can double-tap connect to the TAK server. Easy!
  • Just tap the Auto-import package - that's the first tap.
  • With other platforms, you need to download a Client Package and import it to your app.

slides.title: TAK Page - Instructions
slides.html:
• If you want to see the first-time instructions again, click the "info" button on bottom right.
  • If you want to see more instructions in-app, tap "Open instructions."

blocks.html: \nAfter seeing Deploy App - TAK, continue to TAK Clients
